speaker: Sheldon
text: Checkmate. Obviously you're not well suited for three dimensional chess. Perhaps three dimensional candy land would be more your speed. Just reset the board. Must be humbling to suck on so many different levels.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Yeah, right here.

speaker: Leonard
text: Again. How was Nebraska?

speaker: Penny
text: Hi guys. Did you get my mail? Better than North Dakota.

speaker: Penny
text: I guess that joke's only funny in Nebraska.

speaker: Sheldon
text: From the data at hand, you really can't draw that conclusion. All you can say with absolute certainty is that that joke is not funny here.

speaker: Penny
text: Boy, it's good to be back.

speaker: Leonard
text: How's your family?

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, it was the worst trip. Everyone got sick over the weekend.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Sick. Here we go. What kind of sick? I don't need you to guess. I need you to know. Now, when did the symptoms first appear?

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, the flu, I guess.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, maybe Friday?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Friday. Was that morning or afternoon?

speaker: Penny
text: I, I don't know.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Think, woman, who blew their nose and when?

speaker: Leonard
text: Sheldon, relax. She doesn't have any symptoms. I'm sure she's not contagious.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Oh, please. If influenza was only contagious after symptoms appear, it would have died out thousands of years ago. Somewhere between tool using and cave painting, Homo habilis would have figured out to kill the guy with the runny nose.

speaker: Leonard
text: Then you'll have to excuse Sheldon. He's a bit of a germaphobe.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, it's okay. I understand.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Thanks for your consideration. Now please leave.

speaker: Leonard
text: You'd better go before he starts spraying you with Lysol.

speaker: Penny
text: Okay, well, thank you for getting my mail.

speaker: Leonard
text: No problem. Welcome home.
